overview: A clean, modern single-page website for G Dental Clinic with soft colors, clinic information, services, reviews, and a WhatsApp booking button.
features: Sticky header with smooth-scroll navigation and a WhatsApp Book Now button
Hero section with clinic name, tagline, and 4.9 star rating badge
About section with doctor profile and trust highlights
Services grid covering dentures, extraction, root canals, cleaning, fillings, and braces
Hours and location with address, timings, and click-to-call
Appointment request form that saves requests and confirms on screen
Fully responsive layout for mobile and desktop
